'''June 2000 Michigan tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wizards of the Coast Lakeside, Michigan on 14 June 2000. [[Jason Aubry]] won it. It is known from Jason Aubry's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d893">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00d893/ wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00], DeckTech (Jason "TrenchRunner" Aubry, 14 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-14-wizards-of-the-coast-michigan-6-14-00d893/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast Lakeside, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Aubry]]
